discarded_claims.claim: No POL-RD-07(ii) independent source exists on this record: the chat log carries no driver admission of a detour (the driver reports only that his navigation display refreshed and he continued), the fare_breakdown's erp_gantries array is empty so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, the driver's counterparty_statement denies the detour rather than admitting the route, and fare_breakdown.distance_charged_km (15.0 km) is a copy of the trace figure rather than an independent derivation. POL-RD-07(iii) therefore applies and the outcome is ESCALATE under POL-RD-10(3), which holds the disputed SGD 5.80 rather than collecting it.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver, the same answer applies to both of you: this dispute cannot be settled on the present evidence, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now.

What the record shows. Trip TRP-09115 (Upper Thomson Grove entrance to Yio Chu Kang South community hall, 22 Sep 2026) is recorded on EV-TRIP-09115 as 15.0 km driven against an 11.0 km routing-engine optimal — a 4.0 km / 36.4% excess — and the rider contests SGD 5.80 of the SGD 26.60 charged.

The GPS trace is impaired. EV-GPS-09115 carries a 160-second gap between consecutive fixes, 20:03:10 to 20:05:50, with a 1.35 km straight-line jump across it. That breaches both the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a) and the 500 m limit in POL-RD-07(b), and the gap sits inside the very stretch the rider disputes. The admissibility pre-pass independently tags the artifact IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP. I name that artifact, its weight and its issue code as POL-GEN-02(3) requires.

Consequence. Because the trace is impaired for policy purposes, POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on the trace alone; one INDEPENDENT source is needed — a driver admission in the chat log, charged ERP gantries placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, a counterparty statement admitting the route, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km the platform derived independently of this trace. None exists. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries array is empty. The chat log (EV-CHAT-09115) records only the rider reporting that the route display jumped and the driver answering that his own navigation display refreshed and he continued — a display glitch, not an admission of a detour. The driver's statement denies any extra stop or detour request. And the 15.0 km on the trip record and on the fare breakdown is the same trace measurement in another place: POL-RD-01 itself calls trip_record.actual_distance_km a rounded convenience copy, and POL-RD-07(ii) excludes a billed distance that copies the trace. POL-RD-07(iii) therefore applies: the claim is not sustained on this record, and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because this is a data failure and not a finding for the driver.

Trigger and confidence. POL-RD-10(3) makes escalation mandatory on exactly these facts. Independently, the fact this case turns on — the impaired measurement — is carried solely by EV-GPS-09115 at weight 0.6, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped at 0.6 and falls below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, which fires POL-RD-10(1) as well. Confidence is set at 0.6. Escalation is terminal: the disputed SGD 5.80 is held, not collected or refunded, and both money fields are null. What would resolve it for the reviewer: continuous fixes covering 20:03:10–20:05:50, or any POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry matched to the trace off the optimal corridor, or a platform-derived distance independent of this trace.

The remaining points. The rider's figures are correct on their face — 4.0 km and 36.36% clear both POL-RD-01 gates, and had the deviation been established the POL-RD-02 recomputation would run on the METERED fare as ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.831, giving a SGD 5.80 refund — but that excess is drawn from the impaired stretch and cannot be used while the trace stands uncorroborated. The driver's points are accepted: 36.4% and 4.0 km fall short of the 50% and 8.0 km materiality tests, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 610 completed trips, so no POL-RD-06 pattern, uplift or conduct referral arises. The exculpatory routes are likewise unavailable: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09115-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot run; no pickup or dropoff amendment exists (POL-RD-05); both chat messages carry waypoint_hint null and name no road, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test could not be run; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12). No clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty.

Audit note. Two rider claims — the POL-RD-07(ii) 'no independent source' claim and the POL-RD-08 burden claim — were discarded at the citation check for citing the impaired EV-GPS-09115 without disclosing that impairment or naming GPS_GAP, contrary to POL-GEN-02(1). The substance of both is preserved by the driver's surviving claims and is reflected above.
